agyos_skill.instructions: The growth engine for **YouTube Shorts** — a discovery engine that, since late 2025, is **fully decoupled from long-form**. Different rules, different metric, separate strategy. (Long-form is the sibling skill **youtube-long-form**; don't run them as one plan.) 1. **brand-profile** — what the channel is about, its niche, non-negotiables. 2. **voice-builder** — so the Short sounds like the account (and dodges AI-slop suppression). Shorts have **no thumbnail and no click** — so CTR is irrelevant. The algorithm watches **Viewed vs Swiped Away** above all, then retention. Each Short is tested on a small interest-based **seed audience**, and the **first 30–60 minutes decide** whether it spreads or dies. Write every Short **backwards from the swipe.** (Full mechanics: `references/shorts-algorithm-2026.md`.) Climb four rungs in order (depth: `references/the-retention-ladder.md`): - **Stop (0–3s):** beat the swipe — on-screen text + striking first frame, readable on mute. Target ~75%+ viewed. (hook-writer.) - **Hold (~70%+ avg % viewed):** one idea, relentless pacing, burned-in captions, an intentional loop (chase >100% for replays). - **Angle (information gain):** a genuinely unique take — the Anti-Repetitive AI suppresses recycled formats; volume without novelty is a negative. - **Bridge:** Shorts are discovery; bridge to the channel/long-form **manually** (the engines are decoupled) and via keyword-rich titles for Shorts search. Up to 3 minutes, but bimodal — **<30s** for completion, **~50–60s** for total views; design the idea first, then the shortest complete length. Post **~3–7/week** (consistency over spam); note **"The Flattening"** deprioritizes Shorts after ~28–30 days, so keep shipping. Output is a **shootable script** (on-screen text, VO, shots), captioned, with a keyword-rich title. Hook patterns, caption specs + worked scripts: `references/hooks-retention-and-captions.md`. Drafts here; **does not publish directly**. Full wiring: `references/publishing-funnel-and-tools.md`.
